cards.issue: Published observational comparison (harvest not randomised) on bark harvest
cards.why_it_matters: Mean long-term growth rate λ 0.999 in harvested populations vs 0.985 in the comparison populations (difference +0.015; 4 vs 1 matrices).
cards.uncertainty: Site-specific: results come from Mount Oku, Cameroon (per thesis; COMPADRE plot labels only). One unharvested plot vs four harvested plots (once or twice per year), 1997-1999. No DOI; single control plot means the contrast has no replication on the control side.
cards.recommended_next: Use it as a scenario in the Studio; local stage counts and recovery measurements are still needed before setting any limit.

cards.issue: How sensitive this population is to the harvested process (survival and growth of established plants)
cards.why_it_matters: About 99% (95% range 98–100%) of this plant's long-run population growth depends on survival and growth of established plants, the process a bark harvest affects (16 published matrices, this species).
cards.uncertainty: No conflicts found with the audited studies. This says how sensitive the population is to the harvested process. It is not a safe harvest rate.
cards.recommended_next: Use this to judge which local measurements matter most (e.g. survival of large plants), not as a harvest limit.

cards.human_review_status: shown with caveats; awaiting expert review

cards.issue: With good and bad years mixed in
cards.why_it_matters: Simulating 20,000 years that randomly draw from the published matrices, the harvested populations grows (λs 1.006) and the unharvested ones shrinks (λs 0.9845).
cards.uncertainty: Each simulated year draws one of the published matrices at random: a model of year-to-year variation, not a forecast. Harvested and unharvested matrices often come from different sites.
cards.recommended_next: Compare this with local monitoring before drawing conclusions.

cards.recommended_next: Ask the CITES Management Authority (forestry ministry) for the current quota, the allocation for your area and the management unit's inventory status.
